venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 10/4 (MOD & Chef KE DJ).** Net sales $884 vs target $1,727 (-48.8%). Food $102. Comps $35 / 3.9% (one service recovery drove most of it on low sales). 35 guests, check avg $26. Slow start, little going on until after 9:30; Oktoberfest in Germantown pulled traffic away; last day of October test. Movie night (ET and Signs) sparked conversation. Saw fishmonger friends and a party from New York, one works at a bar near Death & Company NY. Kitchen: smooth sailing. Favorite moment: walking an older guest who can no longer drink through the zero-proof cocktails; reminiscing about ET with regulars.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 10/4 (AM Maggie H; PM Carey).** Net sales incl. events $5,363.92 vs target $10,623 (-49.5%). Food $1,236.25. No events. Comps $323.28 / 6.03% (a guest and partner sampled much of the menu; server's very low sales inflated the %). 124 guests (Tock), check avg $43.26. Super slow evening; thought there might be a pop around 7 but it was a fluke. Kitchen: easy Sunday, no issues. First staff meeting planned Monday.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Rain early on wrecked our momentum
venues.narrative: **EV — Sunday 10/4 (MOD & Chef Kyler, Will).** Net sales $4,542 vs target $4,344 (+4.6%). Food $589, beverage $3,913, retail $40. Comps $128.99 (mostly snaiquiris/amaro for friends & family). 135 guests, check avg $34. Quiet night, rain early deterred walk-ins; room filled around 9; never hit a real waitlist except a brief one for a large party in town for a hospitality conference (seated within ten minutes). 135 covers, 5 large parties, 4 solos, 7 investor cocktails; 23% of parties >2 people. Top sellers: Native Lion, Fries, Long Time Caller/Burner Phone. 2 no-shows. 1 pilsner broken.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 10/4 (AM Sam & Lex; PM Justin & Shannon).** Net sales $8,120 vs target $9,038 (-10.2%). Municipal Bar AM $2,835 / PM $4,516; Sun Club $51; Hot Eye $711. Food $3,272. Comps $233. 246 guests (OpenTable 126 AM + 120 PM), check avg $33.01. Quiet first two hours, picked up before 11; expected 2pm matinee push never came; one food tour of 17. Philharmonic matinee at 3pm let out 4:45 and filled the restaurant with an older crowd; stayed busy for hours, best Sunday in a while; rain at 9pm slowed things. Sun Club sold only 6 drinks. Hot Eye quiet, locals came for the new menu. Maintenance: ceiling vent condensation dripping into guest spaces (complaints); Cryssali bar ceiling drips.

venues.name: D&C Seattle
venues.narrative: **SEA — Sunday 10/4 (MOD Julian Abel).** Net sales $8,700 vs target $10,000 (-13.0%). Food $1,209. Comps $741 total incl. $130 shift drinks (members, industry, guests moved around to accommodate the waitlist). 214 guests, check avg $40.71. Slow start, then Seahawks fans poured in right after the game; Malachi throttled door velocity for a comfortable ~$8k. Prep handled with Anne; no prep person Monday. Red yuzu kosho expected Monday. Maintenance: AAA recharge kit can't be located.
